author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh pumpkin brings warm color and comforting flavor to this rustic village meal 🎃🌿 In this video, we use seasonal pumpkin to prepare two traditional homemade dishes — soft rustic flatbreads and a hearty pumpkin pilaf.

The flatbreads are made with handmade dough and a flavorful pumpkin filling, then cooked until beautifully golden. For the pilaf, pumpkin is combined with fragrant rice to create a warm, satisfying dish with a gentle natural sweetness.

This is autumn village cooking at its best — fresh seasonal ingredients, simple preparation, and comforting homemade flavors. Pumpkin flatbreads and pilaf are a delicious way to celebrate the harvest and enjoy the cozy spirit of the season. 🍂🔥🍚
title: Fresh Pumpkin Cooking | Rustic Flatbreads & Pumpkin Pilaf 🎃🌿
